'''Bastian Winkelhaus Winkelhaus PB3''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds43.htm Winkelhaus PB3], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228020943/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds43.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
